**Ed Watts** was a Hot Wheels employee who worked for Mattel from the 1980s to the early 2000s; he is known to have worked on *Masters of the Universe* figures as well as the [Top Speed](/wiki/Top_Speed) line of Hot Wheels cars. He retired in 2002 due to a stage 4 brain tumor diagnosis, with the Ed Watts Race Team Red Line Club set created to honor him; all the proceeds from the set would go to Watts's family. He unfortunately lost his battle with cancer some time later.
